title: contractSemantics
responsibility: Compares raw JSON values field by field, matching named metadata and duplicate-preserving dependency collections while retaining meaningful example and ordinary array order.

inputs.name: canonicalContract.data
inputs.description: Stored JSON value to canonicalize or classify; historical unknown fields remain intact and JSON string contents retain whitespace.

inputs.name: canonicalContract.path
inputs.description: Raw metadata field path used for collection semantics; empty starts at the document root. Display paths omit only the leading contract prefix.

inputs.name: canonicalContract.ordered
inputs.description: When true, retains all array order to distinguish formatting-only files from otherwise nonmaterial metadata reorderings; defaults to false.

inputs.name: compareContractFields.before
inputs.description: Earlier stored JSON value or contract snapshot; undefined represents an absent field or contract.

inputs.name: compareContractFields.after
inputs.description: Later stored JSON value or contract snapshot; undefined represents an absent field or contract.

inputs.name: compareContractFields.path
inputs.description: Raw metadata field path used for collection semantics; empty starts at the document root. Display paths omit only the leading contract prefix.

inputs.name: isRecord.data
inputs.description: Stored JSON value to canonicalize or classify; historical unknown fields remain intact and JSON string contents retain whitespace.

outputs.name: canonicalContract
outputs.description: Deterministic JSON comparison key. Object key order is ignored; named metadata and known set-like arrays ignore order while examples and unknown arrays retain it.

outputs.name: compareContractFields
outputs.description: Material leaf changes with stable named-item field paths and before/after values; duplicate dependency additions or removals remain separate records.

outputs.name: isRecord
outputs.description: Type predicate accepting non-null, non-array objects; it does not validate a contract schema.

errors.name: TypeError or RangeError
errors.description: Internal callers must provide serialized JSON values; unsupported cyclic or non-JSON values and throwing accessors can propagate native errors.
